WITH 
  immunisation_change AS (
    SELECT 
      "District", 
      "State", 
      "Survey Round", 
      "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS immunisation_rate,
      NULLIF("Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" - LAG("Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)", 1, 0), 0) AS immunisation_change
    FROM 
      "district_health_factsheet"
    WHERE 
      "State" = 'Bihar'
  ),
  round_change AS (
    SELECT 
      "District", 
      "State", 
      "Survey Round", 
      immunisation_change.immunisation_change
    FROM 
      immunisation_change
    WHERE 
      "Survey Round" IN ('NFHS-4', 'NFHS-5')
  )
SELECT 
  "District", 
  "State", 
  "Survey Round", 
  immunisation_change
FROM 
  round_change
